title: Rethinking Actions: Continuity-Aware Priors for World-Model Planning
abstract: arXiv:2611.16645v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Actions in expert demonstrations exhibit temporal structure. An ordered-versus-shuffled analysis across five environments confirms this dependence. We ask whether action proposals that better reflect expert continuity can improve visual world-model planning. Rather than imposing generic smoothness, we learn continuations from the temporal structure of demonstrated actions. Our locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior, LG-DKGP, combines recent and longer-range executed action history, predicts a neural continuation, and learns a temporal Gaussian-process (GP) residual. A training-derived exploration scale initializes search around the corrected mean; a frozen world model evaluates progress toward the goal. Training first fits the neural mean, then jointly optimizes the prior with the GP residual using expert future actions. The resulting planner achieves 87.07\% macro success across five simulated tasks spanning native

translated_title: 重新思考动作：面向世界模型规划的连续性感知先验
translated_abstract: 专家示范中的动作表现出时间结构。在五个环境中进行的“有序对比打乱”分析证实了这种依赖性。我们探讨：更好地反映专家动作连续性的动作提议能否改进视觉世界模型规划。我们并非施加通用的平滑性约束，而是从示范动作的时间结构中学习动作的延续。我们的局部性门控深核高斯过程先验（LG-DKGP）结合近期与较长时间跨度的已执行动作历史，预测神经延续，并学习时间维度上的高斯过程（GP）残差。由训练推导出的探索尺度在修正后的均值周围初始化搜索；一个冻结的世界模型用于评估朝向目标的进展。训练时首先拟合神经均值，然后使用专家的未来动作将先验与GP残差进行联合优化。所得规划器在五个模拟任务中实现了87.07%的宏观成功率。
tldr: 该论文提出局部性门控深核高斯过程先验（LG-DKGP），从专家动作的时间结构中学习连续性先验来生成更好的动作提议以改进视觉世界模型规划，在五个模拟任务中实现87.07%的宏观成功率。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes LG-DKGP, a locality-gated deep-kernel Gaussian-process prior that learns continuations from the temporal structure of expert actions to generate better action proposals for visual world-model planning, achieving 87.07% macro success across five simulated tasks.
